title: Client Acquisition Manager (AP & T)
description:
Position Overview
 
  





 As Client Acquisition Manager, you will own new business for the AP \& Telangana territory — identifying, engaging and closing partnerships with educational institutions and corporate clients. The role combines Go\-to\-Market ownership with hands\-on consultative selling: you will build the acquisition strategy, run the full sales lifecycle end to end, and convert it into predictable, profitable revenue while building relationships that last beyond the first contract.
 



  




 Key Responsibilities
 
  




 Strategy \& Market Expansion
 * Develop and execute the Go\-to\-Market (GTM) strategy driving customer acquisition, revenue growth and market expansion in the education sector.
* Create account acquisition plans and run targeted sales campaigns to penetrate assigned territories and market segments.
* Track market trends, competitor activity and pricing movements to continuously refine acquisition strategy.


 Pipeline \& Prospecting
 * Identify, qualify and prospect new institutional, corporate and strategic accounts in line with company growth objectives.
* Build, manage and nurture a robust sales pipeline through lead generation, networking, referrals and market research.
* Maintain pipeline hygiene in the CRM and deliver accurate weekly and monthly forecasts.


 Consultative Selling \& Deal Closure
 * Conduct customer discovery meetings to understand institutional needs and position the right solution through a consultative approach.
* Manage the complete sales lifecycle — lead qualification, solution presentation, proposal development, commercial negotiation, contract closure and structured account handover.
* Negotiate and close high\-value deals while protecting margin and ensuring profitable growth.


 Relationship \& Account Management
 * Establish and maintain long\-term relationships with principals, correspondents, procurement teams and other key decision\-makers within target organisations.
* Act as the escalation and trust anchor during onboarding, ensuring client satisfaction, retention and repeat business.


 Delivery \& Collaboration
 * Achieve monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets while maintaining healthy profit margins and customer satisfaction.
* Collaborate with Marketing, Product, Customer Success, Operations and Finance to ensure seamless customer onboarding and successful solution implementation.
* Travel regularly across Andhra Pradesh and Telangana to build presence and close business on ground.



  




 Qualifications \& Skills
 * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Marketing or a related field; MBA preferred.
* 8–10 years in B2B sales / client acquisition, preferably in EdTech, education supplies or institutional sales.
* Proven track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets and owning a territory end to end.
* Strong presentation, negotiation, branding and technology skills.
* Demonstrated ability to engage senior stakeholders and build long\-term relationships.
* Working familiarity with CRM systems and sales analytics tools.
* High level of initiative, adaptability and ownership.
* Willingness to travel extensively across Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.



  




 Nice\-to\-Have
 * Prior experience working with schools, school groups or educational bodies.
* Understanding of the education ecosystem and how institutional buying decisions are made.
* An existing network of institutional decision\-makers across AP \& Telangana.

title: Customer Trust Lead
description:
**Recruitment Fraud Alert**
 We’ve learned that scammers are impersonating Commvault team members—including HR and leadership—via email or text. These bad actors may conduct fake interviews and ask for personal information, such as your social security number.
   

  

**What To Know**
* Commvault does not conduct interviews by email or text.
* We will never ask you to submit sensitive documents (including banking information, SSN, etc) before your first day.


 If you suspect a recruiting scam, please contact us at wwrecruitingteam@commvault.com
   

  

**About Commvault**
 Commvault (NASDAQ: CVLT) is the gold standard in cyber resilience. The company empowers customers to uncover, take action, and rapidly recover from cyberattacks – keeping data safe and businesses resilient. The company’s unique AI\-powered platform combines best\-in\-class data protection, exceptional data security, advanced data intelligence, and lightning\-fast recovery across any workload or cloud at the lowest TCO. For over 25 years, more than 100,000 organizations and a vast partner ecosystem have relied on Commvault to reduce risks, improve governance, and do more with data.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 Commvault is seeking a Customer Trust Lead to support customer and prospect security and compliance inquiries and help build confidence in Commvault’s security, privacy, and resilience posture. As a member of the Trust organization, this role serves as a key external\-facing representative, engaging with customers to explain security and compliance concepts and guide discussions toward meaningful, business\-aligned outcomes across security, privacy, data governance, AI, and resilience.
   

  

**What You’ll Do…**
* Serve as a primary point of contact for customer\-facing security and compliance inquiries, including questionnaires, due diligence requests, and customer calls.
* Clearly explain Commvault’s security, privacy, data governance, AI, and resilience posture to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Assess and communicate security and compliance risk at the appropriate level, helping customers move beyond unnecessary detail to focus on true business impact and effective mitigation strategies.
* Review security\- and compliance\-related contract language and customer requirements in partnership with Legal and other internal stakeholders.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally to provide accurate, consistent, and timely responses.
* Represent the Commvault brand externally with exceptional professionalism, polish, and sound judgment.


**Who you are?**
* 5\+ years of experience
* Thorough knowledge of broad security, trust, risk, or compliance topics
* Experience in customer\-facing roles.
* Strong understanding of information security, privacy, and risk management principles.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex topics clearly and credibly.
* Experience supporting enterprise customers in a SaaS or technology environment.
* Expertise with common security and compliance frameworks and standards (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST, privacy regulations).
* Customer\-focused, calm, and confident in high\-stakes or ambiguous situations.
* Able to balance attention to detail with big\-picture judgment.
* Collaborative, pragmatic, and trusted by both customers and internal teams.


 Commvault is an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are always committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status and we will not discriminate against on the basis of such characteristics or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we work.
   

  

 Commvault’s goal is to make interviewing inclusive and accessible to all candidates and employees. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to participate in the interview process or apply for a position at Commvault, please email accommodations@commvault.com For any inquiries not related to an accommodation please reach out to wwrecruitingteam@commvault.com.

title: POC Technical Lead - Senior Principal Consultant
description:
**POC Technical Lead, Applied AI**
**About The Role**
 WRL is looking for a hands\-on
 **POC Technical Lead, Applied AI** 
 to turn validated research hypotheses and enterprise business problems into working, measurable, and transfer\-ready AI prototypes.
   

  

 You will work at the intersection of applied AI research, solution architecture, and rapid prototyping. Partnering with researchers, domain specialists, business stakeholders, and engineering teams, you will design prototype architectures, build end\-to\-end proofs of concept, evaluate technical alternatives, and determine whether a solution is ready to move into development.
   

  

 This is not a coordination\-only or presentation\-focused role. You will write and review code, integrate AI models with enterprise data and systems, build evaluation frameworks, and lead the technical execution of PoCs.
   

  

 Once a PoC is validated, you will prepare the architecture, code, evaluation evidence, technical documentation, and implementation recommendations required for Winfo’s Development and Deployment teams to productize and scale the solution.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Translate research hypotheses and business requirements into focused, time\-bound POC plans.
* Define the minimum prototype needed to test technical feasibility and potential business value.
* Design end\-to\-end architectures for applied AI, generative AI, and agentic solutions.
* Build working PoCs using LLMs, RAG, agents, machine learning, multimodal AI, knowledge graphs, APIs, and enterprise integrations.
* Compare models, frameworks, prompting strategies, retrieval methods, and architecture alternatives using measurable evidence.
* Build evaluation harnesses covering quality, groundedness, robustness, latency, cost, safety, and operational complexity.
* Integrate prototypes with representative enterprise data, applications, APIs, and workflows.
* Ensure that code, configurations, prompts, datasets, experiments, and evaluation results are documented and reproducible.
* Identify reusable components, technical patterns, and potential WRL accelerators.
* Produce clear technical handoffs for Development and Deployment teams.
* Coordinate contributions from AI, engineering, data, cloud, security, product, and domain specialists.
* Mentor AI engineers, POC engineers, and interns.
* Provide technical evidence for decisions to scale, revise, pivot, replicate, transfer, or stop a PoC.


 The WRL operating model progresses qualified opportunities through Research, POC, Decision, and Transfer, with the POC leadership role accountable for prototype architecture and technical handoff.
   

  

**What You’ll Bring**
* Proven experience designing and building end\-to\-end AI or machine\-learning PoCs.
* Strong hands\-on proficiency in Python and modern AI development frameworks.
* Experience with LLMs, RAG, agentic AI, APIs, data pipelines, and enterprise integrations.
* Ability to convert ambiguous research or business requirements into a working prototype and measurable evaluation plan.
* Strong understanding of machine learning, generative AI, model evaluation, and software\-engineering fundamentals.
* Experience comparing models, technologies, platforms, and architectures using evidence.
* Practical knowledge of source control, testing, code review, containers, APIs, cloud platforms, and technical documentation.
* Experience working with researchers, software engineers, data engineers, cloud architects, security teams, and product teams.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical decisions, risks, costs, limitations, and trade\-offs.
* Evidence of taking at least one AI initiative from concept through prototype and engineering or production handoff.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience with OCI, Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Familiarity with MCP, multi\-agent orchestration, vector databases, knowledge graphs, MLOps, LLMOps, and AI observability.
* Experience integrating AI with Oracle, SAP, Salesforce, or comparable enterprise platforms.
* Experience creating reusable AI accelerators, reference architectures, or internal platforms.
* Exposure to healthcare, life sciences, BFSI, or other regulated industries.
* Contributions to open\-source projects, technical publications, patents, white papers, or developer communities.
* Experience mentoring engineers or leading small cross\-functional technical teams.


**What Success Looks Like**
* PoCs answer clearly defined business and technical questions.
* Prototype results are measurable, reproducible, and supported by evidence.
* Weak approaches are identified before significant production investment.
* Successful PoCs are transferred with clear architecture, code, evaluation results, risks, and implementation recommendations.
* Reusable components and patterns are identified across customer use cases.
* WRL develops a disciplined and repeatable POC capability.


**Who You Are**
 You are:
   

  

* A hands\-on builder who also thinks architecturally
* Comfortable working with ambiguity and incomplete information
* Disciplined about experimentation, evidence, and evaluation
* Able to distinguish a polished demonstration from a validated PoC
* Provider\-agnostic and pragmatic about technology choices
* Conscious of quality, latency, cost, security, and maintainability
* Effective across research, engineering, business, and customer teams


**Why Join Winfo Research Labs?**
 You will join WRL at an early stage and help establish how enterprise AI ideas are converted into validated and reusable solutions.
   

  

 You will work across frontier AI, customer innovation, technical experimentation, and enterprise architecture, with the opportunity to see successful prototypes move into real customer environments.
   

  

**Own the journey from validated research hypothesis to working, evaluated, and transfer\-ready AI prototype.**

title: Management Trainee - E Commerce
description:
**Company: Sid’s Farm**
**About Sid’s Farm**
 Sid’s Farm is a premium dairy brand committed to delivering pure, high\-quality milk and dairy products directly to consumers. With a strong focus on freshness, ethical sourcing, and customer trust, Sid’s Farm continues to expand its footprint across modern trade, key accounts, and alternate sales channels.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Sid’s Farm is looking for a dynamic and result\-driven to acquire and manage key accounts, aggregators, and modern trade chains as alternate revenue sources. The role is responsible for driving revenue growth, managing daily sales performance, monitoring offers, ensuring timely receivables, and building strong strategic partnerships.
   

  

**🔍 What You’ll Do**
* Develop and maintain strategic relationships with key accounts to drive sales and revenue growth for Sid’s Farm products.
* Identify, acquire, and manage key accounts, aggregators, and modern trade partners.
* Collaborate with Merchandisers to build a strong pipeline of high\-quality prospects and generate sustained demand.
* Maintain strong working relationships with key partner personnel at head offices.
* Coordinate agent support, including training, merchandising, and below\-the\-line (BTL) marketing execution.
* Develop and deploy effective business propositions to accelerate revenue growth.
* Provide back\-office support including preparing quotations, negotiating pricing, and managing customer onboarding and deployment activities.
* Play a key role in new business pitches and ensure seamless onboarding of new clients.
* Act as the primary liaison between customers and internal teams to ensure smooth coordination.
* Monitor daily sales, promotional offers, and performance metrics across accounts.
* Ensure timely collections and effectively manage accounts receivable.
* Perform account reconciliations to maintain accurate statements and invoices.
* Propose innovative promotions and in\-store activities to improve shelf off\-take and visibility.
* Present periodic reports on account performance, goals, and quarterly initiatives to stakeholders.
* Analyse client data and sales trends to enhance customer relationship management and business outcomes.


**✅ What We’re Looking For**
 Required Skills \& Qualifications
   

  

* Proven experience in sales, business development, and new account acquisition.
* Strong account management and relationship\-building skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with strong negotiation abilities.
* Ability to design and improve distribution processes and revenue channels.
* Experience managing inventory and stock across multiple regions.
* Strong analytical and reporting skills.
* High level of ownership, accountability, and result orientation.


 Why Join Sid’s Farm?
   

  

 At Sid’s Farm, we believe operational excellence is key to delivering freshness and quality to our customers. Join us and be part of a fast\-growing brand that values precision, ownership, and teamwork.
